extracted.intended_audience: potential attendees, fans of improv comedy, and presenters/promoters of live comedy events
extracted.subtask_description: A live, touring improvised-comedy performance (flagship touring show) consisting of a multi-person ensemble performing a long-form, unscripted set that is unique to that performance. The page describes format, tone, ensemble size/skill, and touring/outreach aspects of the show.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unscripted / total improvisation
rubrics_metrics.description: The flagship touring show is a 90-minute, unscripted, and totally improvised performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Described as wholly improvised (no script), implying that performances should be created spontaneously by performers rather than prewritten material. The page emphasizes the unscripted nature as a defining feature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Run time / format length
rubrics_metrics.description: Flagship touring show is a 90-minute performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the expected duration/format of the touring show (90 minutes). This sets expectations for pacing, stamina, and structure suitable for a feature-length improv set.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensemble size and performer caliber
rubrics_metrics.description: Four improvisers at the top of their game perform the show.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates an ensemble of four performers and emphasizes high skill/experience ('at the top of their game') as part of the show's identity — i.e., performer quality is a key criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance energy, surprise, and comedic quality
rubrics_metrics.description: A high-energy, surprising and hilarious show.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the desired tone and audience impact: performances should be energetic, deliver surprises, and be strongly comedic (hilarious). This functions as a qualitative target for style and audience reaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ephemeral / one-off uniqueness
rubrics_metrics.description: A show that 'has never been seen before and will never be seen again.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes the uniqueness and ephemeral nature of each improvised performance; each run is a one-time event, which affects how material is created and valued (no repeats, one-off moments).

rubrics_metrics.name: Touring / outreach
rubrics_metrics.description: Brings some of the best improv comedians from the legendary Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre to new audiences all around the country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights the touring aspect and mission to reach new audiences nationwide; relevant for promotional strategy, venue selection, and accessibility considerations.
